summary.text: Jacey Buckles is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 136, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Republican primary.
A local business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are cost of living, public safety and what he called generational investment.

paragraphs.text: Jacey Buckles earned a bachelor's degree from Southwest Baptist University in 2017.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Buckles said he graduated with a B.S. in Economics/Finance and a B.A. in Religion and Philosophy and has owned and operated a local business since then.
He said the business has grown from one location to three and supports more than 20 local families, and that he serves as its CFO.
Buckles said he and his wife have two young children and that he has been a member of High Street Church for many years and previously served as a deacon.
On cost of living, Buckles said he would focus on reforming taxation, reducing healthcare costs and keeping utility costs low.
On public safety, he described himself as "tough on crime" and said policy should also address the root causes of drug addiction and homelessness.
Under generational investment, he cited broader education options, infrastructure maintenance and development, and making Springfield attractive to businesses.
